text:
anya: Quick sync  trying a new compact "Roles mini" in the invite drawer. Goal: reduce vertical space and make audit + SSO state discoverable without extra clicks. figma: https://figma.redwood.app/file/roles-mini-v3

maya: love the density. Quick UX flags: (1) how do we convey multiple sources (team + direct) without crowding? (2) microcopy consistency for action verbs.

sam: Implementation note: payload already includes sources array per membership. We can render a single-line summary (primaryRole + badges) and expand details on demand. Avoid extra backend calls.

oli: perf note: when orgs have thousands of invites we should virtualize rows and lazy-render expanded content. expanding N rows must be user-initiated.

kevin: accessibility: ensure the expand control is first in tab order inside the row so keyboard users can reveal details before hitting the kebab. Also SSO badge fails contrast at current color; need >=4.5:1 for body text. Add aria-labels for badges.

maya: suggestion for source label: use 'From: infra' visually (short) and aria-label 'Inherited via team: infra' so screen readers get the full context. Keeps visual compactness.

anya: copy question: across drawer and modal we have both 'Add role' and 'Assign role'. Vote to standardize on 'Assign role'. Thoughts?

rachel: +1 to 'Assign role' — clearer in context of an invite.

sam: agree. i'll update component docs. Also propose 'Audit' inline link for rows with recent changes (last 30d) to open /audit?entity=user&id=<id>&filter=roles. Cuts context switching.

kevin: inline 'Audit' should be a link with aria-label 'View audit for <user>' and keyboard-focusable. Also ensure we don't double-announce when tooltip opens; swap aria-describedby so only the tooltip or the badge is read, not both.

maya: visual tweak: replace text-heavy inherited badge with a smaller chevron + team name that expands a11y-friendly details on focus. On mobile, long-press shows full lineage.

oli: will include virtualization + mobile long-press tooltip behavior in the estimate. Also recommend debounce for rapid expansions to avoid reflows.

anya: decision list: 1) standardize verb to 'Assign role'; 2) show primary role + compact badges (From: team, SSO) with aria-labels; 3) inline 'Audit' for recent role events; 4) virtualization + lazy expand; 5) ensure keyboard order + aria-describedby swap. Any objections?

sam: no objections. i'll give a quick frontend estimate once figma tokens and aria copy land.

kevin: small CSS snippet for spec: `.roles-row { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center } .sso-badge { background:#08263B; color:#fff; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:6px } .from-badge { font-size:12px; opacity:.9 }` and `:focus-visible { outline-offset:3px }`.

maya: localization note: 'From:' might not be universal. use token `roles.from_short` so translators can provide tailored short forms.

ui-bot: Created ticket UI-3327 with checklist: tokens, aria copy, perf tests, QA.

anya: thanks. i'll update figma and the spec doc with these decisions. target: dev PR on staging by EOW next week. closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
